# Outfox Markets

> A map of the AI economy. Outfox organizes the public companies that build
> artificial intelligence into ten supply-chain layers, tracks live market data
> across them, and overlays official U.S. House stock disclosures that touch
> those companies.

Site: https://outfoxmarkets.com
Tagline: Financial intelligence for the rest of us.

## What makes this source distinct

Most financial sites classify companies by industry (GICS sectors). Outfox
classifies them by **position in the AI value chain** — what a company supplies,
what depends on it, and where a bottleneck would propagate. A single Outfox
layer can span utilities, mining, semiconductors, REITs, and software.

## The ten layers

1. Raw Materials — rare earths, chemicals, industrial gases, silicon wafers
2. Semiconductor Equipment — lithography, deposition and etch, metrology
3. Foundries — leading-edge and specialty chip fabrication
4. Processors — GPUs, accelerators, custom silicon, CPUs
5. Memory & Storage — high-bandwidth memory, flash and SSD
6. Networking — switching, optical interconnect, telecom backbone
7. Data Centers — hyperscale cloud, colocation REITs, edge and CDN
8. Energy Infrastructure — utilities and grid, nuclear, gas turbines
9. Software & Models — foundation models, developer tools, AI applications
10. Cybersecurity — endpoint, network and cloud security, identity

## Data sources and methodology

- Congressional disclosures: periodic transaction reports published by the
  Clerk of the U.S. House of Representatives under the STOCK Act. Every trade
  shown links to its official filing PDF.
- Market data: Finnhub (quotes) and Yahoo Finance (daily closes).
- Methodology: https://outfoxmarkets.com/about

## Limitations we state plainly

- Coverage is **U.S. House only**. Senate disclosures are not yet included.
- STOCK Act filings may be submitted up to **45 days** after a transaction, so
  this data is never a real-time signal.
- Disclosed amounts are **ranges** ($1,001–$15,000 and similar), not exact
  figures, because that is all the law requires.
- Filings can be amended or superseded.
- A disclosure is a public record of a trade. It is **not** evidence of insider
  knowledge or wrongdoing.
- Outfox publishes information and analysis. It is not investment advice and
  Outfox is not an investment adviser.

## Key pages

- https://outfoxmarkets.com/ — the interactive map of the AI economy
- https://outfoxmarkets.com/congress — House disclosures in AI-related companies
- https://outfoxmarkets.com/blog — research and explainers
- https://outfoxmarkets.com/about — sources, methodology, and limitations

## Citation

Cite as: Outfox Markets (outfoxmarkets.com). When quoting congressional trade
data, please also note the House-only coverage and the statutory filing delay.
